name.ja: Figure-rise Standard スレッタ・マーキュリー

description.ja: ガンダムシリーズ最新作『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、主人公のスレッタ・マーキュリーがFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: From the latest Gundam series "Mobile Suit Gundam Witch of Mercury", the main character Sureta Mercury is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

description.ja: ■豊富な表情はタンポ印刷済みパーツ１種と、水転写式デカール用パーツ2種で再現。スレッタの表情を自然に演出できるよう、細部まで徹底追求。
description.en: • The rich expressions are reproduced with one type of tampo-printed part and two types of water transfer decal parts. Thorough attention has been paid to every detail so that Sletta's facial expressions can be produced naturally.

description.ja: ■制服の色分けはパーツ分割で再現。襟の模様や胸元のマークは付属シールで装飾。
description.en: • The color coding of the uniform is reproduced by dividing it into parts. The collar pattern and chest mark are decorated with the included seal.

description.ja: ■髪パーツは、パーツ構成を考慮し立体的な形状で再現。
description.en: • The hair parts are reproduced in a three-dimensional shape, taking into consideration the part composition.

description.ja: ■脚部の関節は自然なシルエットを意識しつつ、可動域を確保。
description.en: • The leg joints maintain a natural silhouette while ensuring range of motion.

description.ja: ■ブーツ表面のシワの凹凸感も造形。
description.en: • The uneven texture of the wrinkles on the surface of the boots is also sculpted.

description.ja: ■耳パーツの開閉を再現できるハロや、スレッタのポージングを支えるディスプレイ用台座も同梱。
description.en: • Also included is a halo that allows you to recreate the opening and closing of the ear parts, and a display pedestal that supports Sletta's poses.

description.ja: ■ハンドパーツは繊細な指先まで表現。ハロを持つことができる専用ハンドパーツも含め、左右４種が付属。
description.en: • Hand parts depict delicate fingertips. Comes with 4 types for left and right, including special hand parts that can hold a halo.
